about: Held-out test: every gloss block in the DBE Grade 12 SASL Home Language papers and memos the builder was not tuned on (Nov 2018 second set, Nov 2019-2022, May/June and Nov 2023; 2025, Nov 2023 Paper 1 and the Nov 2021 memo 1 correction are in sasl-reference.json and left out). Chosen by a fixed rule before measuring: the question's own sentences without instructions such as "View the clip", the gloss without clip/picture/frame pointers and multiple-choice options, duplicates removed. Many are free renderings of exam questions, not translations. Split: dev-2022 (November 2022) is used to find and fix bugs; final-2023 and final-2018-2021 are never looked at while fixing and give the unbiased figure.

sources.DBE NSC: Department of Basic Education, NSC South African Sign Language Home Language exam papers and marking memos. https://www.education.gov.za
